body_markdown:
Payment gateway onboarding is the process of verifying a business and activating it to accept live payments. With[Razorpay Payment Gateway](https://razorpay.com/payment-gateway/) , merchants can use digital KYC and choose paid onboarding assistance where available. The activation timeline depends on the verification route, business details, and required compliance checks.


For a faster start, check whether existing Central KYC records can be retrieved before preparing a fresh document submission. If you want someone to guide setup, Razorpay also offers paid Assisted Onboarding with a dedicated onboarding manager. These are two useful options to evaluate when speed and access to help matter.


If your dashboard says “KYC under review”, check whether information or documents need clarification. Switching providers does not remove KYC requirements, but verification routes and processing times can differ. This guide explains Razorpay’s onboarding options, documents by business type, clarification requests, and how to get help when activation is delayed.


**Last Updated: October 2026**


## Key Takeaways


- **Fast merchant onboarding in India:** Razorpay offers CKYC-based onboarding that its documentation describes as enabling **activation in minutes** for merchants with successfully verified existing records. Complete any remaining business, bank, and compliance requirements, and confirm the timeline if another verification route is needed.[Onboarding documentation](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/)
- **Dedicated onboarding support:** Razorpay provides a dedicated onboarding manager through **paid Assisted Onboarding** . Its documentation advertises assignment within **1 hour** , activation within **8 business hours,** and assistance through the first transaction. Check the additional fee, availability, and applicable conditions during signup.[Assisted Onboarding](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/#assisted-onboarding)
- **Easier KYC with fewer repeated uploads:** Razorpay can retrieve existing CKYC records and offers DigiLocker, document upload, or Video KYC alternatives where applicable. Choosing the appropriate route can reduce repeated document handling and avoidable back-and-forth. Accurate details and successful verification remain necessary for approval.[KYC verification options](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/)
- **Prepare the right documents and resolve clarifications:** Use the checklist for your business type, enter legal and trade names in the appropriate fields, and provide readable documents and accurate bank details. Respond to the specific dashboard request. A clarification request is different from a final rejection.[Business-specific document checklist](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/business-types-kyc-documents/)
- **Prepare your integration while verification continues:** Use Razorpay test mode to prepare checkout, webhook, and refund flows without real money transactions. Keep test and live configurations separate, and complete account activation and go-live checks before accepting customer payments.[Test-mode guidance](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/)
- **Follow a clear support and escalation process:** Keep your application reference, submission date, current status, and support case number together when requesting help. Contact your assigned onboarding manager where applicable, or use standard support and the published grievance process. Complaint-response timelines and activation timelines are different.[Payments grievance process](https://razorpay.com/grievance-redressal/payments/)


## How Fast Can You Activate a Razorpay Payment Gateway?


Razorpay’s[current onboarding documentation](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/) describes activation in minutes through successful CKYC verification for businesses with existing records. For paid Assisted Onboarding, it advertises manager assignment within 1 hour and activation within 8 business hours. Check which option is available for your business and what requirements remain before planning your launch.


Razorpay onboarding options and published timing Option When it is relevant Timing or access What to check


CKYC verification Existing Central KYC records can be retrieved and verified. Current documentation describes activation in minutes. Complete any remaining business, bank and compliance requirements.


Paid Assisted Onboarding You choose additional help during signup. Advertised manager assignment within 1 hour and activation within 8 business hours. An additional fee applies. Confirm availability, scope and timing conditions.


Document or Video KYC fallback CKYC is unavailable or unsuccessful. Timing depends on the requested checks and review. Follow the verification steps offered for your entity.


Test mode You are preparing your integration. Development and testing access. Test access does not establish live activation.


These published timings describe particular onboarding routes. They do not establish that every application will activate within the same window or that one provider is universally the fastest. Before relying on a timeline, ask when it starts, how business hours are counted and whether additional verification changes it.


### What Can Affect Your Activation Timeline?


- **Entity and ownership details:** An application involving several owners or an authorised signatory may require additional information.
- **Document consistency:** Incorrect legal identifiers or incomplete supporting proof can create clarification requests.
- **Business information:** Your products, services and collection requirements may need additional checks.
- **Bank verification:** Confirm the settlement account details and provide the proof requested if verification is unsuccessful.
- **Website or app readiness:** Provide accurate business information and applicable policy and contact pages.


**PRO TIP:** Ask which verification route applies to your entity before estimating a launch date. Keep the appropriate PAN details and the mobile number linked to your KYC records ready.


## Does Razorpay Provide a Dedicated Onboarding Manager?


Yes. Razorpay offers[paid Assisted Onboarding](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/set-up/#assisted-onboarding) . The documented service includes help through the first transaction, alongside the published assignment and activation timings above. Check the additional fee and applicable conditions during signup.


This option is relevant if you want help understanding setup requirements, completing the application and coordinating questions during activation. It provides a named onboarding contact rather than leaving you to work through every setup question alone. Ask what assistance is included before purchasing it.


An onboarding manager supports setup. Ongoing enterprise account management is a separate arrangement, so confirm what support continues after activation. Do not assume that every merchant receives a free relationship manager or a dedicated compliance team. Compliance decisions still depend on the required checks.


**DID YOU KNOW:** Paid onboarding assistance and standard support are different services. Confirm the scope of each so you know who to contact during setup and after go-live.


## What Documents Do You Need for Payment Gateway KYC?


Prepare documents according to your business structure. An individual, proprietor, partnership and company should not all use the same checklist. Razorpay’s[KYC documents by business type](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/business-types-kyc-documents/) page lists the current requirements, including information retrieved through CKYC and documents needed when retrieval fails.


Document preparation by business type Business type Information to prepare Additional checks to review


Individual or unregistered business Personal identity, address and bank details. Available CKYC retrieval and the fallback identity verification requested.


Proprietorship Proprietor identity, address, business proof and bank details. Accepted business documents and the required number of proofs.


Partnership or LLP Entity PAN, formation documents, signatory details and bank details. Authority to act for the entity and ownership information.


Private or public limited company Entity identity, incorporation documents, signatory details and bank details. Constitutional documents, authorisation and beneficial-owner information.


Trust, society or other supported entity Entity-specific registration or formation proof, signatory details and bank details. The separate checklist for that entity type.


This table is a preparation guide. Use the current documentation and the application itself for exact requirements. Successful CKYC retrieval can reduce repeated uploads, but it does not mean that every business document or bank check disappears.


Enter legal details in legal-name fields and declare brand or trade names separately where requested. A trade name can differ from the legal entity name; the supporting records need to establish the correct relationship. Check that the settlement account belongs to the appropriate person or entity. Supply GST information where applicable.


### Does a Small Business Qualify for an Alternative Due-Diligence Process?


The[RBI Payment Aggregator Directions, 2025](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_ViewMasDirections.aspx?id=12896) permit an alternative process in specified circumstances where CKYCR records are unavailable or cannot be accessed by an aggregator whose authorisation application is pending. The turnover thresholds are up to Rs 40 lakh annually or up to Rs 5 lakh in annual exports.


The process includes PAN or Form 60, physical Contact Point Verification, a certified Officially Valid Document and verification of an applicable business document. Ask whether it applies to you. Turnover alone does not guarantee fewer documents or quicker approval.


## How Does CKYC Help Reduce Repeated KYC Work?


CKYC lets an eligible application use an existing verified record instead of collecting the same identity information again. Follow the PAN and consent instructions shown for your business type. If retrieval succeeds, check the retrieved information and finish any remaining requirements.


If retrieval is unsuccessful, use the alternative route offered in your application. This can involve DigiLocker, document uploads or Video KYC. A failed lookup should not be treated as proof that the whole application has been rejected.


**DID YOU KNOW:** Identity verification and live payment activation are separate milestones. Check the account’s activation status before making a checkout available to customers.


### Digital Verification or Video KYC: What Should You Prepare?


Digital retrieval can reduce repeated document handling. A video call provides a remote verification route when it is required. The time spent entering an OTP or completing a call is only one part of onboarding, so do not use it as the total activation estimate.


Before a video call, prepare the requested original documents and check your connection, camera, microphone and lighting. Follow the provider’s location and verification instructions. If another person is the authorised signatory, confirm who must complete the verification before booking time for it.


**PRO TIP:** If a document is unavailable through the standard digital flow, ask support for the accepted alternative before arranging offline or notarised paperwork.


## Why Does KYC Need Clarification, and How Do You Fix It?


Clarification requests can arise from inconsistent legal details, unreadable documents, incomplete business information or bank-verification issues. Read the actual request before changing your application. A request for clarification and a final rejection require different responses.


Application states and the next action State What it means What to do


Under review The submitted information is being reviewed. Check for pending actions and use support if you need an update.


Needs clarification Additional information or a correction is requested. Respond through the existing clarification flow.


Activated The account is approved for live payment acceptance and settlements. Complete integration and payment-method checks before launch.


Rejected The submitted KYC was rejected. Follow the stated reason and support guidance on the next application steps.


### Four Checks Before Responding to a Clarification


1. **Legal or bank details:** Compare the application with the relevant records. Provide the correction or supporting proof requested rather than changing an unrelated trade name.
2. **Document quality:** Upload clear, complete documents in the formats and size limits displayed in the application. Check that the required information is readable.
3. **Business or GST information:** Declare legal and trade names accurately and supply applicable registration or business proof.
4. **Website or app information:** Provide accurate product or service details and applicable refund, privacy, terms, delivery and contact information.


Reply with the requested corrections and a short explanation of what changed. Keep copies of what you supplied and the case reference. If the application is finally rejected, follow support guidance rather than assuming that resubmitting the same documents will resolve it. A new application with correct details may be needed.


## What Changed Under RBI’s 2025 Payment Aggregator Directions?


The Directions require merchant due diligence, including CKYCR retrieval with consent and permitted alternatives when required. New merchants must be onboarded under the prescribed requirements from 1 January 2026.


The 28 February 2026 wind-up provision concerns specific PA-P entities that failed to apply for authorisation by the deadline. It is not a general merchant-KYC deadline.


For your application, prepare the requested information and check which regulated entity handles payment aggregation. An onboarding manager can help coordinate setup but cannot waive mandatory verification.


## How Do You Get Support When Onboarding Stalls?


Check your dashboard for pending actions, then contact[Razorpay support](https://razorpay.com/support/) through the existing case. Include your application reference, submission date, current status and the specific help you need. If you purchased Assisted Onboarding, use your assigned contact for setup questions within that service’s scope.


### A Practical Escalation Process


1. **Identify the outstanding action.** Note whether the application is under review, awaiting clarification or rejected.
2. **Respond through the correct flow.** Supply the requested information and explain the correction.
3. **Keep one case reference.** Ask which requirement remains outstanding and what the next step is. Include the original submission date when following up.
4. **Use the published grievance process.** If the issue remains unresolved, follow the current[Razorpay payments escalation policy](https://razorpay.com/grievance-redressal/payments/) .


Complaint-response timelines and activation timelines are different. For regulatory escalation, use the[current RBI complaint portal](https://cms.rbi.org.in/) to check coverage and admissibility. This does not guarantee that a rejected merchant application will be approved.


## Can You Test Your Integration Before Live Activation?


Yes. Use test mode to prepare checkout, webhook and refund flows while required verification is completed. It does not involve real money. Live acceptance depends on activation and the payment methods enabled for your account.


Use the[Razorpay Payments documentation](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/) and[API reference](https://razorpay.com/docs/api/) to prepare your integration. Check successful and failed payment handling, webhook processing and refund behaviour supported in test mode. Completing this work in parallel reduces the integration work remaining after approval.


If you do not need a custom checkout, consider whether[Payment Links](https://razorpay.com/payment-links/) or[Payment Pages](https://razorpay.com/payment-pages/) suits your collection flow. These provide different ways to collect payments; the applicable activation requirements still need to be completed.


**PRO TIP:** Keep test and live configurations separate. Finish your go-live checks before accepting customer payments, including confirming the account status and the live payment methods you intend to use.


## How Should You Choose a Gateway for Fast, Compliant Onboarding?


Compare the verification routes available for your entity, published timing and its conditions, assistance available and the clarification process. Ask what standard support includes and what requires a paid or enterprise arrangement. Confirm that the aggregator handling your funds is appropriately authorised.


For Razorpay, begin with the CKYC route and the paid assistance option described above. Prepare your entity-specific documents, address the actual pending requests, and build the integration in parallel. Those steps give you a clearer launch plan than relying on a generic promise of instant approval.


### Check Introductory Offer Terms Separately


Eligible merchants activated on or after 1 July 2026 may receive domestic Payment Gateway platform-fee credits for up to 90 days or Rs 5 lakh in cumulative transaction value, whichever comes first. GST and statutory levies apply. Prepaid cards, corporate credit cards, AMEX, Diners Club and all EMI methods are excluded.


Only the first qualifying MID per PAN/bank account is eligible; merchants who transacted before 1 July 2026 are excluded. A KYC processing fee of Rs 199 plus taxes may apply. Standard fees resume after expiry or exhaustion. Credit-card volume above 90% can trigger withdrawal under fair-use conditions, including retrospective charges. Read the[current offer terms](https://razorpay.com/terms/90-day-free-pg-offer/) . Paid onboarding assistance is a separate service.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### How Quickly Can Razorpay Activate a Payment Gateway?


The published timings depend on the route: successful CKYC can enable activation in minutes, while paid Assisted Onboarding advertises activation within 8 business hours. Confirm remaining requirements and applicable conditions. Document review and fallback verification do not have one universal duration.


### Does Razorpay Offer a Dedicated Onboarding Manager?


Yes, through paid Assisted Onboarding, which advertises assignment within 1 hour and help through the first transaction. Check the fee and service scope during signup. Ongoing account management is separate.


### What Should I Do if CKYC Verification Fails?


Check your submitted details and follow the DigiLocker, document-upload or Video KYC route offered in the application. A failed lookup is different from final rejection. Respond to any additional requests in the dashboard.


### How Can I Reduce Avoidable KYC Delays?


Use the checklist for your entity, enter accurate legal identifiers, supply clear documents and complete bank verification. Keep applicable business information and policies ready, and address the specific clarification requested. These steps reduce avoidable back-and-forth without guaranteeing approval.


### Can I Test Payments Before My Account Is Activated?


Yes. Test mode supports integration preparation without actual money transactions. Use separate test and live configurations, and complete activation and go-live checks before accepting live customer payments.
